the realised form is fixed by the early noise history (sign at 10% of the run predicts the form)

checks.claim: with an asymmetric law the form is predictable from the law alone (must-fail for underdetermination)
a settled form absorbs perturbations below a threshold and is replaced above it: memory of the choice is carried by the attractor, with a finite tolerance
checks.note: the threshold is the distance to the separatrix (x = 0), a property of the law; which side you are on is a property of history

checks.claim: identical statistical states carry no information about which is which; a finite difference on a shared carrier does
checks.note: M6 'finitude enables relation' formalised: relation requires d_Fisher > 0; 'separate'

checks.claim: a Fisher distance exists only between states of the same carrier: 'together' is the shared manifold, 'separate' is the nonzero distance on it

values.distance_between_states_of_different_car: undefined (dimension mismatch); comparison requires a declared common embedding

checks.note: this is the formal content of 'separate and together'; it is a precondition for relation, not a theorem about forms

checks.claim: production-with-memory predicts that the entropy of the next form falls as precedents accumulate; a fixed library (ingression) predicts a constant: an observable difference exists in principle
checks.note: this is Smolin's principle of precedence (fetched in the sweep) in a toy; CRR's M7 shares its direction and has no separate prediction; the ingression model can be rescued by letting the library's weights update, at which point the two are equivalent

checks.claim: the 'why' of the form is a one-bit event at a history-specific moment (the symmetry-breaking time varies across histories); it is in the record of becoming, not in the law or the form
checks.note: this makes the owner's 'I cannot answer that, but that is the point' precise: the answer exists, but only as settled history, which is exactly what M4/M5 say must be kept
